rows.workload: Same fixed pure native task and native provider; separate from whole stdlib and whole release/build admission
rows.method: Checked guarded completion and existing Evidence witness replay; one cold and one warm execution
rows.limitation: Identical output SHA. Source guard test module, not a full public compile-module consumer. No general throughput theorem.

rows.method: Checked guarded completion and existing Evidence witness replay; one cold and one warm execution
rows.limitation: Single samples; excludes context hashing, syntax preflights and whole workflow setup; not statistical speedup or full build improvement.

rows.limitation: Complete stdlib/libgerbil/lang/tools and same-condition whole release/build remain unqualified. Failed original budgets remain failed.

rows.workload: Same fixed pure native task and native provider; separate from whole stdlib and whole release/build admission
rows.method: Checked guarded completion and existing Evidence witness replay; one cold and one warm execution
rows.limitation: Ten real guarded hits; whole parent timed out. Different completed populations prevent a whole build speedup comparison.
